description:
Octopuses don’t just escape, they outsmart. With no bones, nine brains, and intelligence rivaling some mammals, octopuses are famous for pulling off prison breaks that seem straight out of a heist movie. From slipping through gaps the size of a coin to opening jars, unscrewing lids, and memorizing complex mazes, these creatures constantly prove they’re among the most clever animals on Earth.
